name: app-shater-admin-modal-dialogs-grid-with-45-screen-banner
title: Shater admin dialogs grid: dimmed background screens with OTP, confirmation and edit modals
whatItIs: A grid of ten dimmed admin desktop screens, each with a centred white modal in front: an OTP confirmation, a suspend-account form, a confirm-and-notify dialog, a rating breakdown, financial reports and a request-cancellation form, closing in an orange '+45 Screen' banner.
whatItMeans: Rigorous and complete; documenting every dialog state shows the admin experience was designed screen by screen, not assumed.
techniques: Dim the background to focus attention on the modal.
Vary modal content to cover many real admin actions.
Close a documentation grid with a total screen-count banner.

vocabulary.definition: A darkened backdrop used to focus on a foreground modal.
A modal asking the user to confirm an action.
